latest.text: In June 2026, the Internal Resources Division of Bangladesh announced an exemption from customs duty, regulatory duty, value-added tax and supplementary duty on the imports of certain fire-protection equipment.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Duty exemption on imported assistive devices for persons with disabilities
latest.text: In June 2026, the Ministry of Finance of Bangladesh exempted specified assistive devices for persons with disabilities from customs duty, regulatory duty and supplementary duty on importation.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Narrowed scope of import duty exemptions on electric trucks
latest.text: In June 2026, the Government of Bangladesh narrowed the scope of its import duty and tax exemptions on electric trucks, restricting eligibility to vehicles of a higher minimum payload capacity, and extended the exemption period for the vehicles that remain eligible.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Ultra clear float glass added to refrigerator manufacturing duty concession
latest.text: In June 2026, the government of Bangladesh added a further imported input to the concessionary customs duty scheme for the local manufacture of refrigerators and freezers, and extended that scheme by four years.

latest.text: In June 2026, the Bangladesh Ministry of Finance amended the minimum values applicable to imports of various goods. The changes became effective on 11 June 2026.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Re-imposition of customs and regulatory duties on imported air purifiers
latest.text: In June 2026, the Ministry of Finance of Bangladesh rescinded an earlier notification, restoring customs and regulatory duties on imported air purifiers.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Repeal of import duty and VAT reductions for generator manufacturers

latest.title: Bangladesh: Import duty exemptions for solar energy production

latest.title: Bangladesh: Central bank authorizes facilitated exports of goods under B2B2C framework
latest.text: In November 2025, the Bangladesh Bank allowed Authorised Dealers to facilitate exports of goods routed through globally recognized online platforms and marketplaces under a Business to Business to Consumer framework. latest.title: Bangladesh: Export quota of hilsa fish to India in 2025

latest.text: In May 2025, Bangladesh reduced import duties on materials used in the manufacture of electric motors and their parts. The changes are effective from 2 June 2025.

latest.text: In May 2025, the Bangladesh government announced the liberalisation of the de-minimis rule for non-commercial import consignments, increasing the value and duty/tax thresholds. This amendment came into effect on 2 June 2025.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Customs duty on birds' eggs increased
latest.text: In May 2025, the Bangladesh National Board of Revenue withdrew a reduced 15% customs duty on birds' eggs. The withdrawal is effective from 2 June 2025.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Withdrawal of import duty exemption on certain raw materials for footwear manufacturers
latest.text: In May 2025, the Bangladesh Ministry of Finance withdrew exemptions on regulatory and supplementary import duties for certain raw materials used by footwear manufacturers. The measure is effective from 2 June 2025.

latest.title: Bangladesh: Regulatory duty on sugar imports withdrawn
latest.text: In May 2025, the Bangladesh National Board of Revenue announced the withdrawal of the regulatory duty on sugar imports, which was previously 15%.

latest.title: Vietnam: Government amends regulations on gold imports and exports by certain entities

latest.title: France, Germany and Spain: EIB provides financing for 'Amadeus RDI Innovation Programme'
latest.text: On 19 June 2023, the EIB provided financing worth EUR 250 million (USD 271 million).

latest.title: France, Germany and Spain: EIB extends investment support for Grupo Antolín's RDI strategy
latest.text: In December 2020, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Grupo Antolín signed a second loan to support the company's research, development and innovation (RDI) strategy. The first loan was signed in June 2018 (see related state act).

latest.title: France, Germany and Spain: EIB grants investment support for Grupo Antolín's product development investments into interiors for light vehicles
latest.text: In June 2018, the European Investment Bank (EIB) signed a loan agreement with Grupo Antolín Irausa, S.A. to support its innovation, research and development investments concerning light vehicle automotive interiors. The loan will be guaranteed by the European Fund for Strategic Investment (EFSI).

latest.title: Switzerland and Liechtenstein: Commitments announced under the Framework for a United States – Switzerland – Liechtenstein Agreement on Fair, Balanced, and Reciprocal Trade
latest.text: In November 2025, the Swiss and Liechtenstein authorities published a "Joint Statement on a Framework for a United States – Switzerland – Liechtenstein Agreement on Fair, Balanced, and Reciprocal Trade".

latest.title: Iraq: Government announces new import licensing requirements and seasonal import ban on wheat
latest.text: In June 2026, the Government of Iraq announced new import licensing requirements and a seasonal import ban on wheat.

latest.title: Iraq: Permission to export marine and surplus river fish
latest.text: In June 2026, the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture announced the authorisation of exports for marine fish and surplus river fish to international markets.

latest.title: Iraq: Government reduced diesel fuel price for private electricity generator owners
latest.text: In May 2026, the Iraqi government set the price of gas oil (diesel fuel) for owners of domestic private electricity generators at IQD 200 (USD 0.15) per litre for three months.

latest.title: Iraq: Government approves import ban on plastic shopping bags
latest.text: In May 2026, the Iraqi government announced an import ban on plastic shopping bags.

latest.title: Iraq: Government amends wheat procurement prices for the 2025-2026 agricultural season
latest.text: In May 2026, the Iraqi Council of Ministers approved amendments to wheat procurement prices for the 2025-2026 agricultural season, setting within-plan and outside-plan government purchase prices.

latest.title: Iraq: Reopening of Rabia–Yarubiyah border crossing for trade with Syria
latest.text: In April 2026, Iraq's Border Ports Authority reopened the Rabia–Yarubiyah border crossing in Nineveh province after more than 13 years of closure, resuming commercial imports from Syria and restoring outward fuel oil exports.

latest.title: Iraq: Temporary exception to gold import channel restriction
latest.text: In April 2026, the Iraqi government approved a temporary exception allowing licensed gold importers to use the Trebil land border crossing with Jordan, located in Al-Anbar Governorate, as an alternative import channel.

latest.title: Iraq: Ministry of Oil approves emergency import of 200'000 tonnes of Liquefied Petroleum Gas
latest.text: In April 2026, Iraq's Ministry of Oil approved the emergency procurement and import of an additional 200'000 tonnes of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) as a precautionary measure to "prevent domestic shortages".

latest.title: Iraq: Government opens import for five agricultural crops
latest.text: In March 2026, the Iraqi government announced the opening of imports for five agricultural crops.

latest.title: Iraq: Government temporarily permits tomato imports for one month

latest.text: In April 2026, the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) announced that its Board of Directors had approved a USD 10 billion Gulf Crisis Response Programme (GCRP) to shield African and Caribbean Community (CARICOM) member state economies from the economic fallout of the Gulf conflict.

latest.text: In November 2025, the Fund for Export Development in Africa (FEDA), the development equity impact investment arm of African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank), announced a USD 75 million investment in Spiro to accelerate Africa's electric mobility transition.

latest.title: Afreximbank: Launch of the USD 1 billion Africa Film Fund
latest.text: In May 2025, Afreximbank, through the Fund for Export-Development in Africa, launched the Africa Film Fund with a budget of up to USD 1 billion. The stated objective is to support the continent's creative industry.

latest.text: The Nigerian government, through the Bank of Industry, will utilise USD 200 million to expand access to long-term financing for enterprises operating in key growth sectors of the Nigerian economy. The fund is provided by the African Development Bank.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank Provides USD 64 million in support for Levene Energy Development Limited
latest.text: In January 2026, the African Export-Import Bank provided a USD 64 million acquisition finance facility to Levene Energy Development Limited. The funding supports the acquisition of a 30% equity stake in Axxela Limited to expand gas and power infrastructure.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank provides USD 750 million facility to Heirs Energies Limited to support the domestic energy capacity
latest.text: In December 2025, African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) provided a USD 750 million senior secured reserve-based lending facility to Heirs Energies Limited.

latest.title: Nigeria: NCDMB announces USD 100 million equity investment scheme to support local capacity and participation in the oil and gas industry
latest.text: In December 2025, the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB) announces a USD 100 million equity investment scheme to support local capacity and participation in the oil and gas industry.

latest.title: Nigeria: AfDB approves USD 200 million to support local farmers, youth enterprises and MSMEs
latest.text: In December 2025, the African Development Bank Group (ADB) approved a USD 200 million first tranche of the Multi-Tranche Financing Facility for Phase II of Nigeria's Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zones (SAPZ) Program.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank provides USD 1.4 billion financing for Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals Complex
latest.text: In August 2025, the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) signed a USD 1.4 billion financing facility for Dangote Industries Limited to refinance the construction of the Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals Complex. This facility is part of a larger USD 4 billion syndicated financing arrangement.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank provides an extra USD 375 million lending facility to Oando Oil Limited
latest.text: In July 2025, Afreximbank completed the upsizing of a reserve-based lending facility for Oando Oil Limited to USD 375 million.

latest.title: Nigeria: The goverment implements zero tariffs and VAT on imported pharmaceutical
latest.text: On 26 March 2025, the Nigerian government implemented zero import tariffs and VAT on imported pharmaceutical inputs.

latest.title: Nigeria: USD 500 million for Distributed Renewable Energy (DRE) Fund
latest.text: On 12 March 2025, the Nigeria Sovereign Investment Authority (NSIA) announced a partnership for a USD 500 million in funding for DRE Nigeria Fund to develop and finance distributed renewable energy (DRE) projects.

latest.title: Nigeria: NCDMB acquires 20% equity in refinery project
latest.text: In March 2025, the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB) acquired 20 per cent equity in a 100'000 barrels per day refinery project established by African Refinery Group Ltd.

latest.title: Nigeria: Lagos state introduces a 25% discount rate on animal feeds to support farmers
latest.text: On 31 January 2025, Lagos State announced a 25% discount rate on poultry and fish feed to support farmers through the Ounje Eko Farmers Subsidy Program.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank approves USD 200 million facility for BUA Industries Limited
latest.text: In November 2024, Afreximbank approved a USD 200 million corporate finance facility for BUA Industries Limited to support its expansion plans in Nigeria.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank contributes USD 350 million to support Oando Petroleum and Natural Gas Company
latest.text: In August 2024, Afreximbank announced USD 350 million in support of Oando Petroleum and Natural Gas Company Limited's acquisition of a 20% interest in a Nigerian joint venture.

latest.title: Nigeria: Temporary import duty and tax waiver for certain grains
latest.text: In July 2024, the government of Nigeria announced a 150-day tax waiver on certain grains to address inflation.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government stops issuing import licenses for syringes
latest.text: In March 2024, the government of Nigeria announced it had stopped issuing import licenses for syringes.

latest.title: Nigeria: Goverment bans export of Liquified Petroleum Gas (LPG)
latest.text: In February 2024, the Ministry of State Petroleum Resources of Nigeria banned the export of Liquified Petroleum Gas (LPG).

latest.title: Nigeria: Government exempts from duties and VAT the imports of LPG and related machinery
latest.text: In December 2023, the Federal Ministry of Finance of Nigeria exempted from duties and VAT the imports of LPG and related machinery, equipment and spare parts.

latest.title: Nigeria (Gombe): Reduction in price of subsidised fertiliser for farmers
latest.text: In August 2023, the state government of the Nigerian region of Gombe reduced the price of subsidised fertiliser to be sold to farmers.

latest.title: Nigeria: USD 500 million for the agro-industrial sector
latest.text: In July 2023, the Vice-President of Nigeria announced a new support packaged for over USD 500 million for the agro-industrial sector.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government issues import licences to three petroleum traders
latest.text: In June 2023, the government of Nigeria announced it had granted import licenses to three undisclosed petroleum traders.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government starts charging VAT on diesel imports
latest.text: In June 2023, the Federal Inland Revenue Service of Nigeria (FIRS) informed local diesel suppliers that they would start charging the 7.5% VAT on diesel imports.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government Lifts Ban On Charcoal And Processed Wood Export
latest.text: In February 2023, the government of Nigeria announced the lifting of the charcoal and processed wood export ban.

latest.title: Nigeria: Amni International Petroleum Development Company secures a USD 635 million facility from Afreximbank
latest.text: In October 2022, African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) announced the conclusion of a USD 635 million financing agreement with Amni International Petroleum Development Company Ltd., a Nigerian oil firm.

latest.title: Nigeria: Bank of Industry secures EUR 1 billion for MSME lending
latest.text: In August 2022, the Nigerian Bank of Industry concluded a EUR 1 billion (USD 1.01 billion) syndicated term loan for onward lending to the local micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs).

latest.title: Nigeria: Government to invest USD 134 million secured from the AfDB in the boosting agricultural production
latest.text: In July 2022, the AfDB announced the provision of USD 134 million for Nigeria's National Agriculture Growth Scheme – Agro Pocket (NAGS) aimed at increasing food production.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank supports Titan Trust Bank's acquisition of Union Bank Plc with a USD 300 million credit facility
latest.text: In June 2022, Afreximbank announced a USD 300 million Intra-African Investment Financing Facility to back Titan Trust Bank's acquisition of a majority stake in Union Bank Plc.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government cuts tariffs on imported cars and imposes a new levy
latest.text: In April 2022, the Nigerian government cut the tariff on imported cars from 35% to 20% and imposed a 15% National Automotive Council levy.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government bans the import of rice through sea ports
latest.text: In January 2022, the government of Nigeria announced prohibited the imporation of parboiled rice through sea ports.

latest.title: Nigeria: NSIA provides USD 24 million to the solar power sector
latest.text: In January 2022, the Nigeria Sovereign Investment Authority, which manages the country's sovereign wealth fund, announced the investment of NGN 10 billion (USD 24 million) into Nigeria's solar energy sector.

latest.title: Nigeria: African Development Bank disburses USD 170 million in support of Nigerian digital technology start-ups
latest.text: In December 2021, the African Development Bank Board announced the provision of USD 170 million in the funding of Nigerian technology start-ups and SMEs.

latest.title: Nigeria: Central Bank disburses NGN 41 billion (USD 99.7 million) to wheat farmers
latest.text: In December 2021, the Central Bank of Nigeria announced the disbursement of NGN 41 billion (USD 99.7 million) to wheat farmers across the country.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank enters into a USD 1 billion MoU with Bestaf Exploration and Production Ltd.
latest.text: In November 2021, Afreximbank announced a USD 1 billion Memorandum of Understanding with the Nigerian Bestaf Exploration and Production Ltd.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank concludes a trade finance agreement with NNPC
latest.text: In November 2021, Afreximbank announced the establishment of a USD 1.04 billion facility with the Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation (NNPC) aimed at financing oil exploration.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government to provide around NGN 12.3 billion in agricultural subsidies
latest.text: In July 2021, the government of Nigeria announced the provision of an NGN 12.3 billion (USD 30 million) agricultural subsidy to over 2 million Nigerian farmers.

latest.title: Nigeria: Nigerian Central Bank and Export-Import Bank launch Export Stimulation Facility
latest.text: In June 2021, the Nigerian Export-Import Bank announced a naira 500 billion Export Stimulation Facility to support Nigerian non-oil exports with finance.

latest.title: Nigeria (Nasarawa): Nasarawa government enters a partnership with Flour Mills to establish a sugar company
latest.text: In May 2021, the government of the Nigerian state of Nasrawa announced a partnership with the Flour Mills company to establish a sugar enterprise in Toto.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank disburses USD 250 million to support TNOG
latest.text: In January 2021, the African Export-Import Bank disbursed USD 250 million to Trans-Niger Oil & Gas Limited (TNOG) to support its acquisition of the OML oilfield.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government announces Export Expansion Facility Programme
latest.text: In January 2021, the Nigerian government announced a naira 50bn Export Expansion Facility Programme to support export businesses from the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Nigeria: Finance Act 2020
latest.text: On 31 December 2020, Nigeria’s President Muhammadu Buhari, signed the Finance Bill 2020 (the Finance Act or the Act) into law with an effective date of 1 January 2021. The Finance Act included interventions of relevance to the GTA through amendments to the customs and excise tariff, etc (consolidation) act; and the Value Added Tax Act.

latest.title: Nigeria: Bank of Industry initiates USD 1 billion loan scheme for MSMEs
latest.text: In December 2020, the Nigerian Bank of Industry concluded a USD 1 billion syndicated term loan for onwards subsidised lending to domestic MSMEs.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government announces MSME support scheme (Covid-19)
latest.text: In September 2020, the Nigerian Government announced a MSME support scheme to cushion the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank disbursed USD 200 million to Zenith Bank PLC
latest.text: In September 2020, Afreximbank disbursed USD 200 million to Zenith Bank Plc under its Pandemic Trade Impact Mitigation Facility (PATIMFA) to mitigate the effects of COVID-19.

latest.title: Nigeria: The government approves four companies to import maize despite the import ban
latest.text: On 4 September 2020, the government of Nigeria introduced a temporary import quota on maize imports.

latest.title: Nigeria: Introduction of import ban on maize and corn
latest.text: On 13 July 2020, the Central Bank of Nigeria announced introducing an import ban on maize and corn due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Nigeria: Government injects additional USD 150 million in the Nigerian Content Intervention Fund
latest.text: In July 2020, the government of Nigeria announced the expansion of the Nigerian Content Intervention Fund from USD 200 million to USD 350 million.

latest.title: Nigeria: Central Bank of Nigeria introduces an NGN 100 billion credit scheme for the healthcare sector
latest.text: In March 2020, the government of Nigeria launched an NGN 100 billion (USD 274.63 million) credit support line for the local healthcare sector.

latest.title: Nigeria: Import duty waiver on medicines and medical goods
latest.text: On 24 March 2020, the federal government of Nigeria introduced an import duty waiver on medical equipment, medicines, personal protection equipment, and other medical necessities required for the treatment and management of Covid-19 disease in Nigeria.

latest.title: Nigeria: Creation of targeted credit facility for households and SMEs hit by COVID-19
latest.text: On 16 March 2020, the Nigerian Central Bank announced the creation of a N50 billion targeted credit facility for households and SMEs that have been particularly hit by Covid-19.

latest.title: Nigeria: Central Bank imposes restrictions on the import of milk and dairy products
latest.text: On 11 February 2020, the Central Bank of Nigeria imposed an import ban on milk and dairy products, while exempting six companies from the restrictions.

latest.title: Nigeria: NEXIM Bank launches a NGN 50 billion Export Development Facility
latest.text: In April 2019, the Nigerian Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) announced an NGN 50 billion (USD 140 million) Export Development Facility (EDF) to support value-added exports, especially by the Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs).

latest.title: Nigeria: The government introduces local labour sourcing requirements on government procurement-related activities
latest.text: The President of Nigeria on 2 February 2018, signed an Executive Order establishing local labour sourcing requirements on government procurement-related activities.

latest.title: Nigeria: Import tariff changes in 2018
latest.text: According to the WTO Tariff Download Facility, during 2018 the authorities of Nigeria changed their MFN import tariffs at the 6-digit HS code level for a number of products. This entry consolidates all of the applied MFN tariff changes by the reporting country in the year in question. There may be further GTA entries covering some of the same tariff changes which the GTA team has separately reported in the database.

latest.title: Nigeria: Agriculture Finance Scheme through Union Bank of Nigeria
latest.text: On 13 November 2017, the state-owned Nigeria Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending (NIRSAL) in collaboration with the Union Bank of Nigeria, established an Agriculture Finance Scheme.

latest.title: Nigeria: Agriculture Finance Scheme through Stanbic IBTC Bank
latest.text: On 15 September 2017, the state-owned Nigeria Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending (NIRSAL) in collaboration with  Stanbic IBTC Bank, established an Agriculture Finance Scheme.

latest.title: Nigeria: The Federal Industry of Mines and Steel Development signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Bank of Industry
latest.text: According to consistent press reports, a MoU was signed between the Federal Industry of Mines and Steel Development and the Bank of Industry.

latest.title: Nigeria: The Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board plans to increase the budget of the Nigerian Content Intervention Fund
latest.text: The Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB) on 12 July 2017, announced its plan to increase the budget of the  Nigerian Content Intervention Fund (NCI Fund) from USD 100 million to USD 200 million.

latest.title: Nigeria: The government introduces the 'Visa on Arrival' framework for foreign investors
latest.text: The government of Nigeria on 23 May 2017, introduced the 'Visa on Arrival' framework with the intention of facilitating the entrance of foreign investors in the Nigerian jurisdiction.

latest.title: Nigeria: The Federal Government promotes 'Made in Nigeria' products
latest.text:
On 18 May 2017, the President of Nigeria signed an Executive Order 'On support for local contents in public procurement by the Federal Government'.

This Executive Order for the first time establishes that all Nigerian Ministries, Departments and Agencies are obliged to grant preferential treatment to local manufacturers when procuring goods and services.

latest.title: Nigeria: Nigeria Export Import Bank extended a USD 10 million lifeline credit facility to the Golden Guinea Breweries
latest.text: According to consistent press reports, the Nigeria Export Import Bank on 20 April 2017, announced that it had provided a lifeline credit facility to the Golden Guinea Breweries. The financial amount of the facility is USD 10'000'000.

latest.title: Nigeria: The government establishes a new policy for tomato production
latest.text:
The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Investment on 11 April 2017, announced a new policy for tomato production. The scope of this framework is to boost the value chain and investments related to tomato production as well as to increase the overall local production related to this agricultural product.

According to official government sources, the interventions embedded in this policy entered into effect on 07 May 2017.

latest.title: Hungary: Import ban on certain agricultural products from Ukraine
latest.text: In May 2026, the Hungarian government announced an import ban on several agricultural products originating from Ukraine to prevent internal market disruptions.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 71.6 million direct grant to Hankook Tire & Technology Co Ltd for a new radial tyre manufacturing line
latest.text: In April 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid measure from Hungary to support Hankook Tire & Technology Co Ltd.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 10.8 million in emergency support for farmers
latest.text: In April 2026, the European Commission approved EUR 10.8 million in emergency support for farmers in Hungary affected by adverse weather events during the 2025 growing season.

latest.title: Hungary: Export ban on fuels
latest.text: On 9 March 2026, the government of Hungary announced a ban on exports of crude oil and certain fuels to support domestic fuel consumers and safeguard energy supply.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 4.1 billion state aid scheme with grants and tax relief for cleantech manufacturing
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission approved a EUR 4.1 billion Hungarian state aid scheme to support strategic investments in clean technology manufacturing capacity.

latest.title: Hungary: Government announces up to HUF 90 billion in tax reductions for entrepreneurs
latest.text: In November 2025, the Hungarian government announced up to HUF 90 billion in tax reductions for entrepreneurs.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 264 million state aid for Sunwoda Hungary's electric vehicle battery plant
latest.text: In August 2025, the European Commission approved a EUR 264 (USD 307.8) million Hungarian state aid measure to support the establishment of an electric vehicle battery plant in Nyíregyháza. The aid will benefit Hungary Sunwoda Automotive Energy Technology Kft.

latest.title: Hungary: Danube CCS Ventures Kft gets EUR 25 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Danube CCS Ventures Kft for the “Danube Onshore Fermentation Carbon Removals” project.

latest.title: Hungary: OGD Green Storage Kft gets EUR 20.3 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to OGD Green Storage Kft for the “Danube Onshore Fermentation Carbon Removals” project.

latest.title: Hungary: Government launched a programme to support electricity distributors
latest.text: In February 2025, the Hungarian government launched the Digital Renewal Operational Programme Plus, offering HUF 26.5 billion (USD 64.4 million) in non-refundable support to electricity distributors.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 101.7 million grant scheme for animal welfare measures in the pig sector
latest.text: In December 2024, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Hungary to support animal welfare measures in the pig sector.

latest.title: Hungary: Government announces HUF 48 billion in financial grants for local SMEs under the Demján Sándor 1+1 SME Investment Stimulation Support Programme
latest.text: On 5 December 2024, the government of Hungary announced HUF 48 billion (USD 122.87 million) in financial grants for local SMEs under the Demján Sándor 1+1 SME Investment Stimulation Support Programme.

latest.title: Hungary: Government announces HUF 100 billion in preferential loans for local SMEs under the Demján Sándor Capital Programme
latest.text: On 3 December 2024, the government of Hungary announced HUF 100 billion (USD 253.72 million) in preferential loans for local SMEs under the Demján Sándor Capital Programme.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 35 million financial grant to support Hyginett in expanding toothbrush manufacturing plant
latest.text: In June 2024, the European Commission approved a EUR 35 million Hungarian measure in favour of Hyginett Magyar-Amerikai Higiéniai Cikkeket Gyártó Kft.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 156 million to support forestry activities
latest.text: In April 2024, the European Commission approved a Hungarian direct grant scheme to support forestry activities.

latest.title: Hungary: Government launchs non-refundable subsidies support for electric vehicle purchases and charging station development
latest.text: In February 2024, the Hungarian government launched a HUF 30 billion (USD 84 million) program to provide non-refundable subsidies to businesses for purchasing electric passenger cars, vans, or minibuses.

latest.title: Hungary: EIB provides financing for 'SGEF Hu Loan for SMEs and Midcaps II'
latest.text: On 14 December 2023, the EIB provided financing worth EUR 150 million (USD 164 million).

latest.title: Hungary: REPowerEU chapter added to its national recovery and resilience plan
latest.text: In December 2023, the European Union approved an amendment to Hungary's national recovery and resilience plan. The amendment develops a new REPowerEU chapter and allocates additional resources for financing investments and reforms related to sustainable transport and energy transition.

latest.title: Hungary: EIB provides financing for 'MFB Climate Action MBIL - Green Loan'
latest.text: On 18 October 2023, the EIB provided financing worth EUR 100 million (USD 106 million).

latest.title: Hungary: Government announces state aid to LEGO
latest.text: In September 2023, the government announced its financial grant to LEGO for expanding its packaging and warehousing facilities.

latest.title: Hungary:  Government extends and expands temporary import ban on agricultural products from Ukraine
latest.text: In September 2023, the Hungarian government unilaterally extended and expanded the import ban placed on Ukrainian agricultural products.

latest.title: Hungary: Financial aid and tax scheme for facilitating investments in sectors strategic for the transition towards a net-zero economy
latest.text: In July 2023, the European Commission approved a Hungarian state aid scheme for promoting investment in sectors that are strategically important for transitioning to a net-zero economy.

latest.title: Hungary: Financial aid scheme to electricity storage undertakings for efforts to transition to a net-zero economy
latest.text: In June 2023, the European Commission approved a Hungarian state aid scheme to support renewable energy projects with an aim to transition to a net-zero economy.

latest.title: Hungary: Government announces temporary import ban on agricultural products originating in Ukraine
latest.text: In April 2023, the Hungarian Minister for Agriculture announced a temporary import ban on Ukrainian grain and other agricultural products.

latest.title: Hungary: State aid scheme to support companies facing increased energy costs following the Russian invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In April 2023, the European Commission approved a Hungarian state loan and guarantee scheme totalling about HUF 397 billion (USD 1.1 billion) to help companies struggling with increased energy prices following the Russian invasion fo Ukraine.

latest.title: Hungary: Amended state aid measures to provide aid to undertakings affected by the Russian invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In March 2023, the European Commission approved the amendment of two existing Hungarian state aid schemes with a combined budget increase of EUR 6.18 billion (USD 6.5 billion).

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 89.6 million Hungarian investment aid to Samsung SDI's electric vehicle battery plant
latest.text: In February 2023, the European Commission found that the Hungarian investment aid of EUR 89.6 million (USD 95 million) is in line with EU State aid rules.

latest.title: Hungary: EIB provides financing for 'MVM Distribution Network Upgrade II'
latest.text: On 23 December 2022, the EIB provided financing worth EUR 130 million (USD 138 million).

latest.title: Hungary: EIB provides financing for 'Pannonia Bio Proteins and R&D'
latest.text: On 22 December 2022, the EIB provided financing worth EUR 50 million (USD 53 million).

latest.title: Hungary: Amendments to state aid measures to support the economy following the Russian invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In December 2022, the European Commission approved several modifications to previously adopted Hungarian support schemes in the context of the economic crisis. Two schemes also received additional budgets for the extension.

latest.title: Hungary: Approval of EUR 5.8 billion national recovery and resilience plan (COVID-19)
latest.text: In December 2022, the European Union approved Hungary's national recovery and resilience plan and finalised the process necessary to provide financing for the amount of EUR 5.8 billion (approx. USD 6.2 billion).

latest.title: Hungary: EXIM launches factory rescue investment loan program
latest.text: In November 2022, the Hungarian export credit agency (EXIM) announced a program of investment loan support to factories.

latest.title: Hungary: Approval of EUR 10 billion strategic plan for the CAP 2023-2027
latest.text: In November 2022, the European Commission approved the Hungarian strategic plan under the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) 2023-2027. Under the plan, support is allocated to the agricultural sector through direct income payments to farmers, market measures, and rural development support.

latest.title: Hungary: State aid support scheme in form of guarantees and subsidised loans
latest.text: In October 2022, the European Commission approved a Hungarian state aid measure totalling EUR 1'250 million  (USD 1'319 million) of guarantees and subsidised loans under the state aid Temporary Crisis Framework.

latest.title: Hungary: Budget increase of umbrella scheme to support companies in the context of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In August 2022, the European Commission approved the budget increase of the umbrella scheme to support Hungarian companies in the context of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

latest.title: Hungary: Government issues decree on firewood export ban in the context of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In August 2022 the Hungarian government introduced an export ban on firewood in the interest of energy security in the context of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

latest.title: Hungary: Commission approves EUR 500 million loan guarantee scheme to support SMEs in context of Russia's invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In July 2022, the European Commission approved a Hungarian loan guarantee scheme to support SMEs from all sectors in the context of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The scheme was approved under the state aid Temporary Crisis Framework.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 1.14 billion scheme to support companies in context of Russia's invasion of Ukraine
latest.text: In June 2022, the European Commission approved a Hungarian state aid scheme to support companies in the context of Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

latest.title: Hungary: Commission approved EUR 226 million for Crisis Agricultural Guarantee Programme
latest.text: In June 2022, the European Commission approved a Hungarian guarantee scheme to support SMEs across sectors. The scheme was adopted under the Temporary Crisis Framework in the context of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 280 million direct grant scheme to support the tourism sector (COVID-19)
latest.text: In March 2022, the European Commission approved a financial grant scheme from Hungary to support all the sectors involved in tourism in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Hungary: Investment support for the construction of a propylene plant in Tiszaújváros
latest.text: In March 2022, the Hungarian authorities announced a HUF 5 billion investment support in favour of state-owned company Mol Petrolkémiai Zrt to build a propylene plant in Tiszaújváros.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 209 million investment aid to SK On Hungary
latest.text: In March 2022, the European Commission approved an investment aid measure from Hungary aimed at supporting the establishment of an electric vehicle battery cells plant in the region of Közép-Dunántúl.

latest.title: Hungary: Export licenses for grains introduced
latest.text: In March 2022, the Hungarian government announced an export license scheme for grains amidst concerns of meeting domestic demand in light of the situation in Ukraine and rising world market prices.

latest.title: Hungary: EUR 2 billion loan scheme to overcome the investment gap accumulated during the Covid-19 pandemic
latest.text: In March 2022, the European Commission approved a financial grant scheme from Hungary to support undertakings from all sectors when investing, with a focus on sustainable investments.

latest.title: Hungary: Financial aid for the construction of a syringe production plant by the Hungarian subsidiary of Becton Dickinson
latest.text: In March 2022, the Hungarian authorities announced a HUF 4.4 billion investment to complete another investment carried out by US medical technology company Becton Dickinson in the city of Környe.

latest.title: Hungary: Introduction of EUR 24 million measure to support Volta Energy Solutions
latest.text: In January 2022, the European Commission approved an investment aid measure from Hungary aimed at supporting the establishment of a copper foil battery plant in the Hungarian region of Közép-Dunántúl.

latest.title: Hungary: EIB provides financing for the 'Mvm Transmission Network Upgrade' project
latest.text: On 17 December 2021, the EIB provided financing worth EUR 200 million (USD 226 million) in Hungary.

latest.title: Hungary: Licensing requirements introduced for export of construction materials
latest.text: In July 2021, the Hungarian government introduced export licensing requirements on construction material valid from October 2021 due to rising global market prices.

latest.title: Hungary: Financial grant to SKBM for the establishment of an electric vehicle battery cells plant in Komárom
latest.text: In June 2021, the European Commission approved an investment aid measure from Hungary aimed at supporting the establishment of an electric vehicle battery cells plant in the region of Komárom, Central Transdanubia.

latest.title: Hungary: Financial grant scheme to support enterprises offering single wagonload transport services
latest.text: In June 2021, the European Commission approved a Hungarian aid scheme to support enterprises offering single wagonload transport services.

latest.title: Hungary: Increase of financial aid for companies' strategic investments (COVID-19)
latest.text: In May 2021, the European Commission approved the increase of the budget for Hungary's aid scheme to support companies with strategic investments during the COVID-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Hungary: Umbrella scheme to mitigate negative economic effects in tourism sector (COVID-19)
latest.text: In April 2021, the European Commission approved the Hungarian umbrella scheme to support the economy in the COVID-19 outbreak through direct grants and support for uncovered fixed costs.

latest.title: Hungary: EIB and UniCredit Bank Hungary signed credit line agreement to support SMEs and mid-caps (COVID-19)
latest.text: In March 2021, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and UniCredit Bank Hungary signed a EUR 50 million credit line agreement to support SMEs and mid-caps in Hungary.

latest.title: Hungary: Extension of umbrella scheme for financial grants to support enterprises (COVID-19)
latest.text: In February 2021, the European Commission approved a further budget increase and prolongation of the Hungarian umbrella scheme which supports enterprises with financial grants in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Hungary: Third amendment of a scheme to support COVID-19 related R&D projects and products
latest.text: In February 2021, the European Commission approved the third amendment of a Hungarian direct grant scheme to support COVID-19 R&D projects and the production of COVID-19-related products. The scheme was originally approved in August 2020 (see related state act). This amendment prolongs the scheme and add additional budget.

latest.title: Hungary: HUF 214 billion tax relief scheme to support SMEs in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic
latest.text: In January 2021, the European Commission approved a tax relief scheme from Hungary to support SMEs from all sectors in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Hungary: National budgets under CAP's 2021-2022 transitional rules
latest.text: In December 2020, the EU and Hungary established the transitional budgets for the agricultural support given under the European Agricultural Guarantee Fund (EAGF) and the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development (EAFRD) during the period 2021-2022.

latest.title: Hungary: EIB and Hungarian Development Bank (MFB) signed credit line agreement to support SMEs and mid-caps (COVID-19)
latest.text: In December 2020, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Hungarian Development Bank (MFB) signed a EUR 100 million credit line agreement to support SMEs and mid-caps in Hungary.

latest.title: Hungary: Reintroduction of financial grant scheme to support large undertakings
latest.text: In December 2020, the European Commission approved the reintroduction of the direct grant scheme from Hungary to support large companies from all sectors in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Hungary: HUF 47.5 billion scheme to support the economy during the second state of emergency (COVID-19)
latest.text: In December 2020, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Hungary to support undertakings from specific sectors in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: NIB signs EUR 60 million loan with Gren Group
latest.text: In May 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a EUR 60 million loan with Gren Group to support investments in energy infrastructure across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: EIF and Baltic NFIs invest EUR 225 million in the Baltic Innovation Fund 3
latest.text: In February 2026, the European Investment Fund (EIF) and the national promotional institutions of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania announced their investment in a capital fund to support the private equity and venture capital markets.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: EIF and three Baltic banks sign guarantee agreement to support local businesses
latest.text: In July 2024, the European Investment Fund (EIF) and three Baltic banks signed a EUR 720 million guarantee agreement to support local businesses in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: EIF commits EUR 25 million towards a loan scheme for SMEs and mid-caps
